experience.title: Chief Administrative Officer, NY
experience.summary:
Chief Administrative Officer, NY 	April 2021 — Present
VP Property and Fleet Services 	May 2017 — April 2021
National Grid | New York

I am privileged to lead operations for a multinational electricity and gas utility company, a key player with a USD $25B portfolio, headquartered in the UK. After being promoted to oversee broader operations, I manage a 5.5M sq ft portfolio, including 240 buildings and a $3.3B environmental portfolio. I took full responsibility for a $286M operating budget and $100M capex, ensuring every dollar was optimized for maximum impact.

Guiding a team of over 600 employees—50% of whom are union members—I lead nine departments with a strategic vision. I manage the operations of three central distribution warehouses, numerous satellite locations, and $700M in inventory. My role requires strategic leadership, operational efficiency, and an unwavering focus on delivering results.

𝗦𝗲𝗹𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗔𝗰𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗶𝘀𝗵𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀 𝗜𝗻𝗰𝗹𝘂𝗱𝗲:

 Consolidated 3 office locations, slashing US office footprint by 477K square feet and cutting rent by 25% while disposing of 34 properties, returning $62M to shareholders and $63M to customers.

 Spearheaded proposal for a fleet-wide telematics system to monitor 7,000+ assets, aimed at improving asset utilization and shrinking operational costs tied to vehicle idling and underuse.

 Oversee Right or Way and related Legal teams; Secured 250 miles of new Transmission ROW while managing external engagement with communities and local elected officials to avoid media and reputational risks.
 Secured an average of $17M in annual savings over the past 3 years by negotiating remedy reductions to better align with environmental and public risks, as reported to the Environmental Oversight Committee.

 Led cultural shift, improving safety reporting by 70% and reducing OSHA LTIs by 85%, maintaining near-perfect safety record across $3.3B portfolio. Created safety performance committee, training, and video.

experience.title: Director, Real Estate and Property Management
experience.summary:
I was promoted to lead the Real Estate and Property function at a Fortune 500 energy company serving over 4 million customers across New England with electricity, natural gas, and water services. After a major merger, I oversaw a 4.2M sq. ft. portfolio, which included 70 facilities, 43,000 acres of land, and 3,000 miles of rights-of-way. I managed a $36M operating budget and directed $35M in annual capital spending, ensuring optimal use of resources and strategic asset management post-merger. This role required a blend of operational oversight and long-term strategic vision.

 Directed a cross-functional team to build a 40K sq. ft., $28M Transmission Operations Center, ensuring full compliance with North American Electric Reliability Corporation Critical Infrastructure Protection (NERC CIP) standards.

 Spearheaded the creation of a $1.6M Security Control Center to monitor critical assets, utilizing interactive video walls for real-time event sharing and response, significantly improving incident management and decision-making.

 Orchestrated a 20-member executive team to achieve 20% cost savings by reducing buildings from 107 to 70 after the Northeast Utilities/NSTAR merger, securing approval from the Public Utilities Commission.

 Formulated a 5-year plan to optimize 43K acres of surplus property, generating $150M in revenue through divestments and strategic partnerships while supporting business strategies through land conservation.

 Initiated and strategically directed the creation of the nation's first regulated utility-owned Land Trust, preserving approximately 1.1K acres of open space, which helped secure state approval for the merger settlement.

experience.title: Director, Environmental and Property Management
experience.summary:
I led a team of four managers overseeing a diverse real estate portfolio valued at over $ 3B. This included approximately 3,000 miles of rights-of-way, 43,000 acres of land, and thousands of easements. I took full accountability for all real estate activities, from strategic planning and portfolio optimization to new site acquisitions, property dispositions, leasing, and land management. 

In this role, I mentored and coached my team, ensuring we consistently met our goals while driving performance and growth. I successfully executed hundreds of property acquisition and disposition transactions, including commercial, residential, and industrial properties, with a total value of over $116M, delivering strong financial results and enhancing the company’s asset portfolio.

P&L Management

 Expanded rental portfolio by 48%, reaching $19.5M, by implementing assertive operational strategies, including the innovative use of air space and utility poles for solar rentals. Generated cumulative rental revenues of $130M since inception.
Environmental & Social Governance

 Saved shareholders $180M by crafting a less expensive contamination containment solution at a complex remediation site in Holyoke, MA, after consulting with specialists and securing regulatory approval.

 Transformed the corporation's approach to environmental issues from a mere regulatory compliance effort to a proactive, forward-looking operation which enhanced regulatory collaboration and forecasting ability.

 Designed and implemented ISO 14001 Environmental Excellence certification initiative to assure management, employees, and external partners that the company improved and measured ecological impact.

 Prevented a consent order and penalties of up to $1M per day by developing remediation plans and proactively negotiating with the Connecticut Department of Environmental Protection on electrical substations contaminated with PCBs.

experience.title: Project Manager
experience.summary: I planned and executed transmission substation and line-related capital construction projects, overseeing high-voltage electrical systems from initial concept to final closeout. I led cross-functional teams of over 100 employees across Contracts, Planning, Construction, Safety & Environmental, and Maintenance, ensuring seamless project execution and adherence to safety standards. I also worked closely with stakeholders to foster collaboration, address concerns, and maintain strong relationships throughout the project lifecycle.
